headline: K.M. Sugar Mills announces effective date for scheme of arrangement
hook: K.M. Sugar confirms scheme effective date
summary: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited has officially notified the NSE regarding the effective date of its previously announced scheme of arrangement. This procedural update confirms the timeline for the corporate restructuring process. Shareholders and market participants can now account for the implementation schedule in their holdings. The company has fulfilled its regulatory disclosure requirement regarding the scheme's status.
why_it_matters: Clarifies the timeline for corporate restructuring for existing shareholders.
